method: Reviewed full draft against the Yonhap factcheck on winter heating (short outings: lower setpoint 1-2C; away mode for a week or longer; restart consumes the most energy; indoor vs ondol mode selection by insulation and drafts per Kyungdong Navien and Rinnai manuals; district heating 3-day away mode with power always on; 20C setpoint, 7% saving per 1C = 5,150 KRW/month; district heating share 81.8/15.2/3%; gas boiler CO accidents 2017-2021: 21 cases, 46 victims, flue disconnection 9 cases; pipe cleaning +5% efficiency, high-efficiency boiler -10%), the KEA min24 heating operation manual (away mode for well-insulated buildings, 55C or higher when controlling heating by hot-water temperature, frost-protection function needs power, exposed pipe insulation, 2-3 day valve rule) and the KEA efficiency-management knowhow page (full off then restart wastes energy, hot water 55->40C saves 9.4 Nm3 / 8,610 KRW per month, main valve part-close with room valves), the Gas News expert column (ondol 40-50C, 60-65C preheat for 1-2h, indoor 20-22C, hot water 36-42C, cold-wave advisory 15-17C, humidity 40-60%, poorly insulated homes lose heat even at 25-26C setpoint), and the MOLIT policy briefing on CO alarms (2020-08-05 products must ship with an alarm; new gas boiler installations require one). Manufacturer away-mode behaviors (Cuckoo 8C, Rinnai 10 min every 4 h) come from the Seoul Economic Daily. All numbers in the draft are covered by the research record; the Coupang partner link for the CO alarm was issued for the exact product page (6911591845). Range notations in the draft (6-8h, 1-2C, 40-50C, 0.5-1C, 20-22C, 60-65C, 15-17C, 36-42C, 40-60%, 3-4 years, 2017-2021) are additionally covered as concatenated tokens in the research values for the gate's range parser.
